title: ASTM F3001-14(2021) Standard Specification for Additive Manufacturing Titanium-6 Aluminum-4 Vanadium ELI (Extra Low Interstitial) with Powder Bed Fusion
notes: Public ASTM store product page read on 2026-10-15. Active standard; the page lists F3001-14(2021) as current, with F3001-14 and F3001-13 as earlier versions. Committee F42, subcommittee F42.05. Scope as stated on the public page: requirements for Ti-6Al-4V ELI parts made by full-melt powder bed fusion, for buyers and producers who define requirements and confirm part properties. Purchase required. Relevant only if a supplier proposes Grade 23 ELI, which docs/TITANIUM.md reserves for cases where ductility or toughness justify it; the first titanium request names Grade 5. No table is reproduced; the ASTM page states that use of AI on ASTM standards is prohibited, so only designation, title and scope are cited.
